acceptance_defined: 2026-11-04 before first PyCy-to-vendor numerical comparison; existing example unchanged
reference_platform: MATLAB R2025a Update 1 / Simulink / Simscape / Simscape Electrical
known_difference: Official default converter uses switching devices with antiparallel diodes; PyCy uses externally controlled bidirectional Ron/Goff switches. This is a waveform/fundamental steady-state validation under zero-dead-time complementary gating, not device equivalence or automatic-diode certification. Exact native gates, carrier phase, RateTransition and sign mapping must be inspected first; no fitted delay or amplitude compensation is allowed. Preserve detailed active-device parameters in provenance.

feature_criteria.required_power_direction: positive absorption by RL load; current direction verified by fundamental phase
feature_criteria.additional_requirement: All waveform and feature limits apply to all phases, no time/amplitude fitting. Gate/topology differences must be physically explained before a pass is accepted.
